who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane ladder-lower under the ladder lead
what: The body form keeps no literal values (`Lit::Int(suffix)`, `Lit::ByteStr(len)`), so a lowering that feeds both the checker and a builder must carry values in a side column; and the shared lanecheck lock plus crates underneath breaking (blaze-surface's lang_items.rs) left the crate unverified for long stretches though it uses neither blaze-surface nor blaze-file-items.
cost: about twenty minutes waiting on the lock and on another lane's breakage
cause: the body form was designed for the checker alone; the ladder crate's manifest lists dependencies it does not yet use
whys: typeck needs only a literal's kind; the builder needs its value; the walking skeleton links both off one lowering
class: a record shaped for one consumer forces its second consumer to carry a parallel column
prevention: open: give the body form (or blaze-lower's record) a literal-value column read by blaze-build; drop unused manifest dependencies so a lane is not blocked by crates it does not call
workaround: Body::int_value, pat_int_value and byte_str in blaze-ladder
